displayName: North Beach flats (shallow squared bay over a street door)
_comment: #492. Makes bay_northbeach_squared (#473, design #452 §3's 'shallow squared bay - rectangular,
not slanted, which is what distinguishes it from Noe') reachable; it was one of the last two
shipped presets no template placed.
ONE TEMPLATE, NOT TWO. Unlike the Mission this district needs no commercial companion, because
it places no shopfront: §3's other North Beach piece is the corner-entry chamfer storefront,
which has no generator yet. Nothing here can turn the neighborhood commercial, so the
residential/shopfront ratio the Mission needs weights for does not arise. library.json still
authors a weights row, to exclude trivial_window (see below).
GROUND FLOOR: the door alone, centred, and NO garage. North Beach flats are dense and narrow
with almost no curb cuts, and it also keeps floor 0 to a single exact - so the width-gating
arithmetic that door-vs-garage needs in the Victorian templates does not apply here.
THE BAY IS AN EXACT AT FLOOR 1, centred over the entry - the flats' signature. Unlike Noe's,
this one is fully cleared by the window rule beside it: bay_northbeach_squared is 3.05 m wide
against bay_noe_slanted's 3.80 m, so a window clears it at 1.525 + 0.55 = 2.075 m, under the
2.20 m the window rule already excludes (and under its 2.20 m repeat pitch, which
RaisingTheExclusionRadiusNeverChangesTheRepeatRhythm makes the ceiling). The known gap that
remains is the one #491 tracks and Noe shares: _exactMarks is keyed (edge_index, floor) with no
notion of floorsSpanned, so the bay's SECOND floor carries no mark and a window can sit inside
the shell there - occluded by it, not interpenetrating it. It costs triangles, not looks.
NO roofPart: design #452 §3 marks all three shipped cornices exclusive to Noe Valley,
Sunset/Parkside and South of Market, and borrowing one would read as that district. North
Beach's own roofline is not built.
NOT RENDERED. `North Beach` is outside the play-area map.osm bbox (chunks_wintest is 1002
buildings, all Glen Park), so this template has never been looked at in the Editor - the same
reason #475 declined to add it. What is verified is the authored data: TemplateWiringTests.
